content: <rss version="2.0"><channel><title>ESPN NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/</link><description>ESPN public league news</description><item><title>Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley agrees to plead guilty in sports betting case</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50301040/malik-beasley-agrees-plead-guilty-sports-betting-case</link><description>Malik Beasley is scheduled to change his plea at a Dec. 9 hearing in Brooklyn.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:45:58 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/0701/r1683045_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Fantasy basketball points league rankings update: George, Jerome on the rise</title><link>https://www.espn.com/fantasy/basketball/story/_/id/49960162/fantasy-basketball-points-league-rankings-2026-27-nba-season</link><description>Updated fantasy basketball rankings for points leagues, with Ty Jerome, Paul George and Davion Mitchell among the biggest risers.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:20:23 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1026/r1736711_2_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Jazz's Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) out 6-8 weeks, sources say</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50300264/jazz-jaren-jackson-jr-knee-6-8-weeks-sources-say</link><description>Utah will be down two more of its bigs as Jaren Jackson Jr. has a torn MCL in his right knee and will miss at least six weeks, while Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a sprained wrist.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:40:40 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1027/r1737121_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Hornets to retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50299731/hornets-retire-muggsy-bogues-no-1-jersey</link><description>The Hornets will retire Muggsy Bogues' No. 1 jersey on Feb. 11. Bogues, the shortest player in NBA history, is the franchise leader in assists, steals and minutes.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:40:44 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2014/0520/sn_g_mbts_1296x729.jpg" /></item><item><title>Tuesday's fantasy basketball adds and bets to make in the NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/fantasy/basketball/story/_/id/50299185/fantasy-basketball-tips-nba-betting-picks-today</link><description>Eric Moody breaks down Tuesday's four-game slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 17:55:04 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1027/r1737063_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Stephen A. goes on epic rant over Kawhi's latest injury</title><link>https://www.espn.com/video/clip/_/id/50298555/stephen-goes-epic-rant-kawhi-latest-injury</link><description>Stephen A. goes on epic rant over Kawhi's latest injury</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 16:11:14 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://espnmedia-cdn.akamaized.net/espn/media/common/2026/1027/ss_20261027_120535881_3713088/ss_20261027_120535881_3713088.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
